# Names replaced

These screens were measured from the real program. A crew seat's name in them has been replaced by a neutral one
of the same length, so that no crew seat's name appears in the framework's tests: the seat's name in the first message's echo is now 'unit' (the same length), in idle.txt, paste-shown.txt, working.txt and working-queued.txt. Nothing else in them
was changed: no character, row, width or style other than those letters.
